nat᷑ ab hoste. Cõtuꝰ gͦ m̃bͦꝵ mo¬

pugͣtĩos dec ñ cͤare de partita
te uictꝰ. nã gͣue ẽ ultͣ armoꝵ
põd̾a ⁊ eoꝵ q̃ reqͥrũt᷑ ad defẽstonẽ
ex̾titꝰ deferre ĩ hñdãtia uictuali¬

ad eẽt pugͣntib ciboꝵ ub̾tas ad¬
huc eẽt eis ncciͣa ciboꝵ abstĩentia
⁊ ñ gͣuare se ex niiio cibont me¬
liꝰ possẽt tolłare pugͣndi laborẽ.
¶Qrͣto dec eos ñ curare de ĩcõ¬
moditate iatendi ⁊ standi. nã
expedit alñ pugͣntib die noctu
q ĩ armis eẽ pp̃ qd̃ ñ ĩstãdo nͨ ĩ
iacẽdo: eis cõmod̃ aut reqͥes.
nto dec ip̃õs pp̃ iusticiã ⁊ ꝯͥ

nã cũ toͣ op̃o bellica exposita sit
ꝑicłis mortis. Nñꝙͣ qͥs: fortis aĩo
⁊ hoꝰ bellator nͥ aliqͦmͦ sit ĩpauidꝰ cͣ
ꝑicła mortis. Spͨtat .n. ad fortẽ ⁊
ad boͫ bellatorẽ ut ĩmiit ph᷒ .iii.
etħ. ñ care ĩ bello bñ mori. Tũt .n.
qͥs dr̃ bñ mori ĩbello qñ bellãt iꝰ
te ut ꝑ defẽsione prĩe ł ꝓalio io
magnoboᷤ iuste ⁊ audactꝰ expotuit
se ꝑitłis mortis. d̾ ã qͥs ultͣ ꝙͣ debe¬
at diligͭ corͣlẽ uitã de facili agit
t᷑pẽ fugã. ¶Sexto pugͣntes ẽẽ
